description:
The historical price data for Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) contains a data error that is distorting the performance chart. Identify and remove the erroneous low-price quote (outlier) from the security's history.

A portfolio file is provided at /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/amzn_glitch.xml. Open this file in Portfolio Performance if it is not already open.

To complete this task:
1. Locate the 'Amazon.com Inc.' security.
2. Access its Historical Quotes tab.
3. Find the single data point in July 2023 that is clearly incorrect (price near $0.01).
4. Delete that specific entry.
5. Save the changes to the file.
